import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

class PlaceOrderCommand {
  constructor(readonly actor: { id: string }) {}
}

const anActor = () => ({ build: () => ({ id: 'actor-1' }) });

function arrange() {
  const saved: string[] = [];
  const commandBus = {
    execute: async (command: PlaceOrderCommand): Promise<string> => {
      saved.push(command.actor.id);
      return 'order-1';
    },
  };

  return { commandBus, saved };
}

describe('Place order', () => {
  it('saves the order and answers its identifier', async () => {
    const { commandBus, saved } = arrange();

    const id = await commandBus.execute(new PlaceOrderCommand(anActor().build()));

    expect(id).toBe('order-1');
    expect(saved).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('completes without answering anything', async () => {
    const { commandBus } = arrange();
    const command = new PlaceOrderCommand(anActor().build());

    await expect(commandBus.execute(command)).resolves.toBe('order-1');
  });

  // TODO(domain): replace each entry below by a test named after the business behaviour.
  it.todo('applies the business decision to the order');
  it.todo('saves and publishes nothing when the command is refused');
});
